subject: My ShinyApp runs in RStudio but fails as a ShinyApp

messages.author: b983b9bbef7f7acb
messages.subject: My ShinyApp runs in RStudio but fails as a ShinyApp
parts:
I'm having an issue that I can't debug and was hoping someone here can help. My Iris app is a simple ShinyApp for making a prediction about the iris class based on user-inputted petal length and width. To do this, the app uses the built-in iris dataset as well as caret and rattle libraries. It runs fine on my computer and seems to deploy successfully to ShinyApps.io, but when I go to the app's webpage, I get an error message saying that "The application unexpectedly exited. Diagnostic information has been dumped to the JavaScript error console."

My ShinyApp is at: https://dnaeye.shinyapps.io/iris/

Copy of the code is at: https://github.com/dnaeye/iris
